label: 2021 Men's NORCECA Volleyball Championship - 27th edition
source: BUILT from cited bytes under WO-VB-4 (PLAN-VB + CENSUS-VB-4), Director-approved 6-edition batch commit. Capture: Wikipedia edition-page wikitext (action=raw); official match count == built count; FIDELITY per-team pool points recomputed == printed standings spw/spl (deviations, if any, proven arithmetically and disclosed); spine/table-top asserts exact. 27th edition, Durango City, Mexico, 18-23 Aug 2021. Format: 2 pools of 4, pool winners (MEX, CUB) byes to SF, 2nd/3rd to QF, 4ths to 5-8 bracket. Champions PUERTO RICO - FIRST NORCECA TITLE IN THEIR HISTORY (MVP Arturo Iglesias) d. Canada 3-0 in the final after knocking out Mexico-in-pools' conquerors; hosts Mexico bronze; PUR+CAN qualified for WCh-2022 (both in store). NORCECA scoring quirk byte-read: 5/4/3-2/1/0 match points (not FIVB 3/2/1). FIDELITY CATCH #4 OF THE WO: Pool A standings print Canada 214/197 but recomputation from match rows forces 204/207 - the printed pool is internally broken (spw sum 834 != spl sum 814) while MEX/PUR/TTO entries incl. points conceded TO Canada all recompute exactly; corrected-with-proof, both values documented. Sources: official norceca.net per-match P2 result PDFs (as-printed URL drift disclosed: matches 1-8 print norceca.net, 9-11 www.norceca.net long-form, 12-22 short MATCH-N form).
